notes.title: AdventureX 2024 - 10/11
notes.content:
[h1]Broadcast during the AdventureX 2024 Steam sale.[/h1]

AdventureX is the UK's only convention dedicated to narrative-driven gaming. Since 2011, AdventureX has been bringing together developers & gamers with a passion for interactive storytelling.

I have been fortunate enough to both exhibit and speak at the convention.

AdventureX 2024 is a digital event featuring a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/adventurex2024]Steam Sale[/url] with over 140 incredible narrative adventure games.

notes.title: Heir of the Dog Kickstarter funds in LESS THAN 2 HOURS!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44471773/64ed0d661e7879678683547e56d0afce0ca742aa.jpg[/img]

[h1]Roll up, roll up[/h1]
[b]The [url=https://heirofthedog.co.uk/ks]Kickstarter campaign for Heir of the Dog[/url], has launched.[/b]

The [url=https://heirofthedog.co.uk/ks]campaign[/url] will be live until 13th August and has a variety of digital and physical add-ons to choose from, From big boxes crammed with goodies, to exclusive signed loot, and even a chance to bag a boxed version of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/Lucy_Dreaming/]Lucy Dreaming[/url] in our "Double box bundle".

[url=https://heirofthedog.co.uk/ks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44471773/b297f6c12f7c073bdd9486249e28e86b22ebcba3.png[/img][/url]

[b][url=https://heirofthedog.co.uk/ks]Check out our cool Kickstarter rewards and add-ons[/url][/b]

[h2]Watch our Kickstarter video[/h2]
[previewyoutube=-DnnW6hGZVY;full][/previewyoutube]

Tom x

notes.title: Heir of the Dog Kickstarter pre-launch page now LIVE!
notes.content:
[url=https://heirofthedog.co.uk/ks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44471773/69a64d3a919821c7fff5838f6e2333580d5fce3a.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]🎉 Heir of the Dog Kickstarter pre-launch page live![/h2]

I've finally got myself organised and published the [url=https://heirofthedog.co.uk/ks]pre-launch Kickstarter page for Heir of the Dog[/url]. I'm planning to launch the campaign later this year, but there will most likely be some early bird rewards, so make sure you hit the [b]"Notify me on launch"[/b] button to be notified the instant [url=https://heirofthedog.co.uk/ks]the campaign[/url] goes live!

[url=https://heirofthedog.co.uk/ks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44471773/9af31daa9587cdc04a4e175854d3a2d5d68968cb.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2][url=https://heirofthedog.co.uk/ks]Follow on Kickstarter[/url][/h2]

-----------------------------------------------

[h2]🌟 What about rewards?[/h2]
I've got loads of cool ideas for both in-game and physical rewards, including chances for backers to appear in the game itself, and (of course) a big box to sit proudly on the shelf next to Lucy Dreaming. On that note, I am also hoping to provide a reward bundle which includes the big box of Heir of the Dog as well as a [b]new re-print of the Lucy Dreaming big box[/b] with its final, gorgeous artwork.

[url=https://heirofthedog.co.uk/ks][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44471773/d882e79611061a7ea4465672811cc8840ec17d30.png[/img][/url]

[b]So, watch this space, and don't forget to hit that green button on the [url=https://heirofthedog.co.uk/ks]Kickstarter pre-launch page[/url].[/b]
